title: Docking
description: Docking with the station by hand or by the auto-dock. The feature document, docking.md, is the primary record.

entities.name: Docking by hand
entities.description: The pilot flies into the station's slot, lined up and level, and is inside.
entities.behavior: When the player is inside the station's docking box, four checks decide: the station is not hostile, its slot faces the player, it is nearly dead ahead, and the slot is level with the player's wings. All four pass: the countdown is cancelled and the 16-tick docking tunnel starts, while the rest of the tick still runs. A failure is the combat rules': death at speed 5 or more, otherwise a bump.
entities.outcome: Docking is a skill that ends every run in safety.
constraints: The box is DOCKING_BOX (128) sim units on each axis.
The thresholds are SLOT_FACING, DEAD_AHEAD and SLOT_LEVEL; FATAL_DOCKING_SPEED is 5.
No collision with the station's hull outside the box (RULES B.23 Q-B16).
A dying player or one already in a tunnel does not dock.

entities.name: Auto-berth
entities.description: With the docking computer fitted, a press docks at once from anywhere in the safe zone.
entities.behavior: The auto-dock press succeeds when the auto-dock is fitted, the station is present and it is not hostile; the docking tunnel starts and the tick's later queued actions and the laser are skipped. Otherwise nothing happens.
entities.outcome: A safe way in for a pilot who can afford it.
constraints: It does not fly the ship in: the baseline docks at once (RULES B.22).

relatedViews.relationship: The pilot's goals that exercise it.
The station and its safe zone.
Applies a failed docking's bump or death.
